help: Run data, search, export, Nautilus, optional model and the paper hand-off in one process
description: One foreground process that calls the stage libraries in-process: pin the data window, search (tune or sweep), validate the exported bundle strictly, replay it in NautilusTrader with a report-only parity block, optionally train a metalabel model, then hand off to paper (shadow, no venue orders). It never starts a daemon or anything live. A manifest is written atomically after every stage to <out-dir>/pipeline.json, and every stage records the equivalent single command. The evidence traps are not computed. Exit 0 when every requested stage completed, 1 on the first technical failure (partial manifest), 2 when refused before any work.

--symbol.help: Hyperliquid coin, e.g. BTC, kPEPE or xyz:TSLA (default: BTC, or the bundle's with --export)

--timeframe.help: bar size (default: 1m, or the bundle's with --export)

--lookback-days.help: calendar days of history, minimum 30 (default: 90, or the bundle's with --export)

--refresh.help: ignore the cache and re-fetch in the data stage; later stages never refresh

options.help: read history only from the local cache; a cache miss exits 1
search stage: tune (Karpathy or Optuna autotuning) or sweep (grid over the strategy's track)
tune sampler: karpathy (random-adaptive with elite zoom) or optuna (TPE)
start from this strategy bundle (a directory, a candidate id under exports/, or latest); skips data and search
skip the NautilusTrader replay and its parity block
position-sizing conviction (0..1) for the sweep, Nautilus and paper
train a walk-forward metalabel model into <out-dir>/model (never installed)
run a foreground shadow paper session for this many live bars, 1..1440 (default: hand-off only)
run directory, which must not exist (default: runs/pipeline/<pipeline id> under the data root)
print the resolved plan (stages and their commands) and exit without writing
